worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.summary: Press the world's primal power out from underfoot: a dome of ancient energy blasts everything around (airborne foes included) outward and upward, raising ground runes; the receding wave may temporarily raise the user's five combat stats by one stage. Deep-source form is narrower and heavier; wide form is broader and faster with a stronger shove.
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.use.0: Blast a ring of foes off you when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.use.1: Catch airborne targets too, not just the ground
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.use.2: Attack during the temporary five-stat surge
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.descripti: The primal burst deals %1$s special damage with a %2$s block radius.
Caught foes are pushed %1$s blocks outward and lifted %2$s blocks up.
After a hit, has a %1$s chance to raise Attack, Defence, Special Attack, Special Defence and Speed by %2$s for %3$s. Repeated triggers refresh one layer.
It reaches about %1$s blocks vertically; deep-source is currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.ancientpower.preferenc: On: blast radius ×0.82, power ×1.12 and surge chance +0.05, but longer wind-up and cooldown — for crushing one hard target in a tight ring and leaning on the surge. Off (wide form, default): coverage ×1.15, stronger shove and a faster cast — for covering a small patch.
The companion only considers ancient power within this distance; smaller casts it only at point-blank, larger is willing to close in first.
Cast only when at least this many visible, hostile foes stand inside the blast radius; 1 throws it at the first foe (building stats over time), higher keeps it for when surrounded.
